'When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it. / Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Gain {r}{r}. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.'

Direct sibling of the adopted evo/cogwerx_base_arms.json (same ON_EQUIP steam counter, same gated INSTANT); only the payoff differs - GAIN RESOURCE_POINTS 2 instead of MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK.

Every handler re-verified against source this session: PUT_COUNTER reads counter_type/amount and defaults target to the source card (effect_types.py:2015-2058); GAIN reads asset/amount and routes RESOURCE_POINTS to effect_gain_resources (:4869-4889); the REMOVE_COUNTERS COST reads counter_type/amount (cost_types.py:548-573); FLAG_SET reads raw membership in the controller's current_turn_effects (condition_types.py:1032-1037); ability_keywords.boost appends exactly the marker 'boosted_this_turn' once per boost, unconditionally (ability_keywords.py:514) - so release note 1 ('the banished card does not have to be a Mechanologist') holds: any paid boost sets it. The triage suggestion DID_THIS_TURN('boost') was wrong: EVENT_THIS_TURN's event set has no 'boost'.

PLACEMENT: activation_cost/per_turn are authored at CARD level, not inside the INSTANT ability. compile_card reads them from the top-level dict only (loader.py:153-154); an ability-level copy lands unread in ab_params (loader.py:120-125) - the adopted arms.json carries them ability-level, which is inert there; do not copy that placement.

COST LOOP CLOSED: effect_put_counter writes BOTH card.counters and the player-level (slug, zone, kind) tally (ability_keywords.py:1653-1660), and the cost's can_pay sums that player-level tally (cost_types.py:556-560), so the steam counter put on equip is visible to the cost. KNOWN WRINKLE: the cost's pay decrements only the player-level dict (cost_types.py:561-572), leaving card.counters stale - harmless here (one counter, per_turn 1, once-per-turn blocks a second activation), but a future card-level COUNTER_GTE read on this equipment would over-count after activation.
